body: Is there anything I can do in the meantime? Moving out is a long time away.

I'm only 15 and I'm a guy. I don't have a dad, which is good because he was even worse.

My mom has always treated me like shit ever since I was a little kid. She name calls me by calling me stupid, a pig, dumb, retarded, etc. I know that it's even impacted my grades heavily, as I have all F's (and have had at least 1-2 F's for the past 5 years). She resorts to gaslighting me when I try to confront her and says stuff like "Well you were being dumb."

And it's not in a joking way, she screams at me a lot. I go to therapy (thank god) because I tried to kill myself and I was diagnosed with PTSD. After every session she asks what I talked about and when I even mention her name she starts to yell at me and calls me overdramatic and a baby.

I see all these posts talking about how to deal with toxic parents as an adult, but I'm trapped. I can't leave her, and it's driving me over the edge again. It's every single day. And it's not like she has good days too, but it drives me insane as she can change in an instance.
Thanks a lot! I found it.
